## Currency Registry (CR)

Dated exchange rates as data: one base (booking) currency, rate rows carrying value + as-of date + source, and `staleAfterDays` — the policy line that makes "old" a judgment the book itself renders. The isolated view shows each rate’s age and whether Resolve Currency would accept or refuse it. Rates are records, not an API call, because the audit question is always "what rate did we use that day".

### Example

Desk Book (USD base): fresh EUR/GBP fixes and a deliberately stale JPY row showing the refusal state.

### Non-goals

No live rate feeds (recording is deliberate). No triangulation between two foreign currencies — everything resolves through base.
